title: Kneeling Orca Selfie
description: A woman with black hair and headphones kneels on a black and white checkered floor, holding a selfie stick with an orca-themed phone case. She wears a white and pink ruffled top, red shorts, pink leg warmers, and has a large mallet beside her, with a massive orca whale behind her in an underwater cathedral hall filled with small fish.
prompt: A young woman with black hair and white headphones kneeling on a black and white marble checkered floor inside a flooded gothic cathedral with massive stone columns and rose windows. She is taking a selfie with an orca-themed phone on a long selfie stick, wearing a white crop top with pink ruffles and orca silhouette, red shorts, and pink leg warmers. A giant orca whale swims behind her while smaller orcas and fish swim around the flooded hall, dramatic blue underwater lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
